question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Break one's duck**

options.text: Achieve a first success after previous failures

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e., Achieve a first success after previous failures. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Break one's duck"** means to achieve a first success after previous failures or to accomplish something for the first time, often after a streak of unsuccessful attempts. (पहली बार सफलता प्राप्त करना) • **Example:** After struggling for weeks, the batsman finally broke his duck by scoring his first run in the match. • **"Duck" **in cricket terminology refers to scoring zero runs. Breaking one's duck metaphorically means overcoming that streak of zero. (शून्य से बाहर निकलना) • **Example:** After several failed attempts, she broke her duck and finally won her first chess match. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1 - Abandon a hobby** (शौक को छोड़ देना): To give up or stop pursuing a pastime or activity you previously enjoyed. • **Example:** He decided to abandon his hobby of painting after moving to a new city. • **Option 2 - Spoil a good start** (अच्छी शुरुआत को खराब करना): To ruin a promising beginning or initial progress. • **Example:** The team spoiled a good start by making several mistakes in the second half. • **Option 4 - Undergo bankruptcy** (दिवालिया होना): To experience financial failure or insolvency, where one is unable to pay debts. • **Example:** The company underwent bankruptcy after years of financial mismanagement. 36:T9cd, The correct answer is: **Joyous**.
